import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int n, k, mod;
    static long[][] dp;
    static int[] list, bi;
    static int cnt_list, cnt;
    static long[] fac, inv, len;
    static boolean[] vis;

    static long power(long a, int n) {
        long ret = 1;
        long base = a % mod;
        while (n > 0) {
            if ((n & 1) == 1) {
                ret = (ret * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            n >>= 1;
        }
        return ret;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        mod = sc.nextInt();

        if (n % 2 == 1) {
            System.out.println(power(k, n));
        } else {
            fac = new long[n + 1];
            inv = new long[n + 1];
            len = new long[n + 1];

            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                if (i == 0) {
                    fac[i] = 1;
                } else {
                    fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % mod;
                }
            }

            inv[n] = power(fac[n], (int) (mod - 2));
            for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                inv[i] = (inv[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % mod;
            }

            list = new int[33];
            cnt_list = 0;
            for (int i = 0; (1 << i) <= n; i++) {
                if (((n >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                    list[cnt_list++] = i;
                }
            }

            dp = new long[n + 1][1 << n];
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                len[i] = 0;
                int j = i;
                while (j != 0) {
                    len[i]++;
                    j = (j - 1) & j;
                }
            }

            vis = new boolean[1 << n];
            for (int i = (1 << n) - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                if (i == 0) {
                    break;
                }
                vis[i] = true;
            }

            dp[0][0] = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
                    if (dp[i][mask] != 0) {
                        for (int sub = mask; sub > 0; sub = (sub - 1) & mask) {
                            int l = (int) Math.min(k, len[mask - sub] + 1);
                            for (int s = 1; s <= l; s++) {
                                if (dp[s - 1][mask - sub] != 0) {
                                    dp[s][mask] = (dp[s][mask] + dp[s - 1][mask - sub] * inv[sub]) % mod;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            long ans = 0;
            int limit = Math.min(k, (int) len[n]);
            for (int i = 0; i <= limit; i++) {
                if (dp[i][(1 << n) - 1] != 0) {
                    long tmp = dp[i][(1 << n) - 1];
                    tmp = (tmp * fac[k]) % mod;
                    tmp = (tmp * inv[k - i]) % mod;
                    tmp = (tmp * inv[i]) % mod;
                    tmp = (tmp * fac[n]) % mod;
                    ans = (ans + tmp) % mod;
                }
            }
            System.out.println((power(k, n) - ans + mod) % mod);
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
